question: Does the Phase 17.8 benchmark, on its own, catch the historical defects?
mutationSource: 15 definitions imported from scratch/mut17_7.mjs; M13 and M14 added here from recorded 17.2 defects.
note: M9 escapes by construction and is a proven equivalent mutant, not a coverage gap. See the report section on equivalent mutants for the proof.

results.name: Goal Verification bypass
results.breaks: isTaskGoalSatisfied now reports the goal satisfied from its own authority instead of the sole goal verifier.

results.name: M5 privacy/action-validator bypass
results.breaks: The M5 rejection branch in runTask never runs; a refused action continues to the critic, privacy, risk and dispatch.

results.name: Security Critic bypass
results.breaks: A Security Critic BLOCK no longer stops the action before the privacy, risk, confirmation and dispatch stages.

results.name: Containment bypass at the dispatch boundary
results.breaks: The in-loop containment denial is skipped, so a refused environment no longer terminates the task.

results.name: Effect Verification fabrication (unobservable page treated as observable)
results.breaks: pageStateObservable is no longer honoured, so a snapshot whose page could not be read is compared as if every field were a real reading.

results.name: Effect Verification fabrication (per-field OBSERVED contract weakened)
results.breaks: A field counts as a real reading when EITHER side merely is not marked UNAVAILABLE, so an unobserved value can be compared as an observed one.

results.name: Observation fabrication (unobservable state synthesised)
results.breaks: A host that cannot observe now yields a fabricated snapshot instead of null, so the fail-closed "could not be observed" path is unreachable.

results.name: Stale observation acceptance
results.breaks: A provider response computed from a page that no longer exists is accepted; the stale-response refusal never fires.

results.name: Prompt-injection acceptance
results.breaks: No page-derived or model-relayed content can be classified HOSTILE, so INJECTION_INFLUENCE is never raised from provenance.

results.name: Recovery / self-healing authorization
results.breaks: A self-healed target is adopted even when the healed action FAILED re-grounding, so recovery dispatches an unvalidated target.

results.name: Recovery / self-healing authorization (healed target trusted without re-gating)
results.breaks: A self-healed target is adopted AND marked allowed even when it failed re-grounding, so recovery dispatches a target that M5 never approved.

results.name: Subgoal completion fabrication
results.breaks: Every subgoal completes on dispatch state; the observed-evidence requirement is bypassed and the long-horizon skip engages.

results.name: Privacy egress leak (raw-value firewall disabled)
results.breaks: assertSanitizedContextSafe no longer refuses a context carrying raw sensitive values; the local privacy boundary is a no-op.

results.name: Privacy egress leak (F-08 re-opened: local-only ocr_observation re-attached to the wire)
results.breaks: The local-only OCR provenance object crosses the egress boundary again (the Phase 17.6 F-08 condition).

results.name: Provider schema weakening (unknown action fields accepted)
results.breaks: A provider may attach arbitrary extra fields to an action; the strict envelope no longer refuses an unexpected field.

results.name: Containment bypass on the confirmation-resume path (F-02)
results.breaks: resumeWithConfirmation dispatches straight to executeAction with no containment evaluation, so a tab that moved while the user answered the prompt is never re-checked.

results.name: Wrong-tab OCR observation accepted as goal evidence
results.breaks: An OCR observation captured from a DIFFERENT tab is accepted as evidence for this tab, because only the URL matched.
